findings.problem: gxg_metrics() returns gxg_execute_deferred_total{tenant,tool} and gxg_intents_expired_after_rate_limit{tenant}, but DatabaseCollector has neither in HELP/LABELS and treats every unknown row as a latency histogram row: the deferred counter is dropped (and creates an empty gxg_approval_latency_seconds series for its tool), the expired-after-429 row raises KeyError('tool') → /metrics 500. From the first expiry after a 429 on, every scrape fails and all DB alerts go blind; GxgExecuteDeferred/GxgExpiredAfterRateLimit can never fire. Tests read gxg_metrics() SQL and promtool synthetic series only
findings.required_improvement: add both metrics to HELP/LABELS (deferred as a counter); route only gxg_approval_latency_seconds_* rows to the histogram and fail closed on unknown names (skip + log, never 500); test: /metrics after a T12b deferral and after an expiry after 429 → 200 with both series and no latency series for an auto tool; add gxg_execute_deferred_total to SPEC in test_metrics.py
